name: 49201 · Jackson, MI
findings: ZIP 49201 (Jackson) has 141 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49201 (Jackson) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 49201 (Jackson) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 46 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
